name: laravel-icon-registry
description: Completes icon keys from ympact/laravel-icon-registry in Blade and PHP.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In an untrusted workspace, completion reads an existing manifest and PHP is never run.

commands.title: Icon Registry: Search and Insert Icon Key

iconRegistry.manifestPath.markdownDescription: The manifest to read, relative to the workspace folder. Matches the package's `editor_manifest` config key.

iconRegistry.autoExport.markdownDescription: Run `php artisan icon-registry:export` when the manifest is missing and when watched files change. Trusted workspaces only.

iconRegistry.phpCommand.markdownDescription: The command that runs PHP, for example `["./vendor/bin/sail", "php"]`. A user setting only, so a repository cannot choose what gets executed.

iconRegistry.watch.markdownDescription: Files that trigger a new export when they change, relative to the workspace folder.
